description: This file defines the interface for an IPC receiver component, including function signatures, enums, and macros for handling IPC requests, server socket creation, shutdown, and statistics collection in a service-oriented architecture.

methods.name: startRequestHandler
methods.description: Creates a server socket to listen on a specified port and process incoming IPC requests using a provided handler, with configurable thread pool parameters.

methods.name: shutdownRequestHandler
methods.description: Closes the server socket to stop processing incoming requests, typically during shutdown.

methods.name: waitForRequestHandlerToShutdown
methods.description: Blocks the calling thread until the request handler has shut down.

methods.name: collectIpcStatistics
methods.description: Gathers statistics about IPC handlers and populates a provided stats container.
